query: For my 69‑year‑old man inpatient with diabetes and acute HF, among men aged 64–74 report initiation percentages by antidiabetic class (insulin, metformin, sulfonylureas, DPP‑4, SGLT2, GLP‑1, TZDs) first 12h vs final 48h.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, d.drug_class, SUM(CASE WHEN h.intime BETWEEN a.admittime AND a.admittime + INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN h.intime BETWEEN (a.dischtime - INTERVAL '48 hours') AND a.dischtime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS proportion FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN pharmacy ph ON a.subject_id = ph.subject_id JOIN poe po ON ph.poe_id = po.poe_id JOIN prescriptions pr ON po.poe_id = pr.poe_id JOIN d_items d ON pr.itemid = d.itemid JOIN chartevents h ON a.subject_id = h.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = h.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 69 AND p.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND d.drug_class IN ('insulin', 'metformin', 'sulfonylureas', 'DPP-4', 'SGLT2', 'GLP-1', 'TZDs') GROUP BY p.gender, d.drug_class;
